purpose: Fast cross-chat/cross-agent reconstruction of the current RealSaS scientific and product context. This is a compact state graph, not a history log.

product.name: RealSaS
product.target: 8-direction editable 2D/2.5D puppet compiled from raster artwork; preserve 2D appearance while inferring/editing mechanical rig and deformation.
product.next_visible_product_milestone: Mage idle/breathing after Geppetto + Arachne FIT1 closure

pipeline.name: IRIS
pipeline.role: learned image perception / signed geometry and support evidence
pipeline.canonical_rule: evidence only; no final canonical IDs

pipeline.name: GSA/RiggingSurfaceIR
pipeline.role: deterministic assembly/validation/provenance of lossless per-view surface evidence

pipeline.name: Geppetto
pipeline.role: learned skeleton/control proposal, parent/root evidence, future mechanical salience
pipeline.canonical_rule: architecture promotion currently on AR-01 hold

pipeline.name: Compiler
pipeline.canonical_rule: no geometry-only dedup; no hidden deform-node completion; canonical IDs after exact solve

pipeline.name: Arachne
pipeline.role: learned skin/weight/deformation proposal conditioned on qualified skeleton + IRIS/Geppetto outputs
pipeline.canonical_rule: future FIT1 training; SkinTokens clean-room mechanism audit planned

pipeline.name: Runtime
pipeline.role: consume qualified/proof-owned puppet state and motion
pipeline.canonical_rule: must not replay solver/evaluator authority at export/runtime

current_focus.scientific_question: Does minimal joint+parent mechanical recurrent feedback improve Mage FIT1 reachability/retention and structural prediction relative to matched feedback-off AR0?
current_focus.scope_warning: AR-01 is a minimal feedback intervention, not a full RigAnything formulation test.
current_focus.promotion_block: No Geppetto refreeze/promotion before AR-01 closes under preregistered rules.

riganything_state.critical_memory_rule: Never propose building a RigAnything-equivalent challenger from scratch without first inspecting the existing challenger and its experiment lineage.
riganything_state.canonical_status: research implementation only; component tests do not imply full-formulation closure

geppetto_current_architecture.known_historical_reason: old hard-MAP locus feedback was removed because multimodal crossover could rewrite later anonymous states; this did not prove all skeleton-causal feedback unnecessary
geppetto_current_architecture.lossless_evidence: binding consumer-boundary requirement; do not regress to summary-only 24D authority
geppetto_current_architecture.mechanical_salience: open neural responsibility; explicitly outside AR-01 and must not migrate into Compiler heuristics

fit_science.principle: FIT1 fits a generic/generalization-oriented architecture to one witness; architecture is not designed specifically for FIT1.
fit_science.fit_specific_optimizer_interventions: scientifically legitimate inside FIT1 when preregistered, but cannot be relabeled generic/generalization evidence

settled_invariants: Compiler final legality is deterministic exact qualification.
Compiler cannot silently repair Geppetto by geometry-only dedup or hidden cardinality/deform-node synthesis.
Canonical IDs are minted after exact solve.
Lossless per-view evidence must survive into learned consumers.
Mechanical salience / functional simplification belongs to neural Geppetto-side evidence, not legality heuristics.
Source existence != mechanism test; mechanism test != full formulation test; FIT1 != generalization.
No post-hoc gate widening after results are visible.

execution_environment.reason: routine hosted Actions usage previously triggered a quota/usage warning; avoid high-volume hosted/fan-out workflows

known_context_traps.trap: Confusing a research challenger with canonical Geppetto
known_context_traps.defense: Check architecture ledger row + implementation path + canonical status separately.

known_context_traps.trap: Calling AR-01 a RigAnything formulation test
known_context_traps.defense: Experiment ledger explicitly limits AR-01 to the minimal feedback delta.

known_context_traps.trap: Treating old restoration/hold reports as current authority
known_context_traps.defense: CURRENT_STATE + authority map outrank historical reports; historical docs are evidence only unless explicitly promoted.
Execution authority is local self-hosted RealSaS runner.

known_context_traps.trap: Reconstructing state by reading many reports in arbitrary order
known_context_traps.defense: Read REHYDRATION_PACKET first; descend only through referenced ledgers/artifacts.

continuation_protocol.rule: Do not infer current truth from filename recency, branch recency, report count, or memory alone.
continuation_protocol.experiment_completion_definition: result/provenance + implementation + experiment ledger + architecture ledger if affected + context state + CURRENT_STATE if stop/go changes + explicit supersession/revocation
